name: tail-browser-mcp
description: Control Mozilla Firefox: tabs, history and web content (privacy aware)
long_description:
This MCP server provides AI assistants with access to browser tab management, history, page search, and webpage content through a local MCP connection.

Install the Tail MCP browser extension (Firefox or Chrome from this repository). Each install registers with a unique browserId on ws://127.0.0.1:18789. Use list-connected-browsers and pass browserId in tool calls when multiple browsers are connected.

Before accessing webpage content, explicit user consent is required per domain in the extension. No shared secret is required by default (localhost trust mode); set EXTENSION_SECRET optionally for HMAC signing.

extension_secret.title: Extension secret (optional)
extension_secret.description: Only if HMAC signing is enabled on the MCP server (EXTENSION_SECRET). Leave empty for localhost trust mode.

port.title: Extension Port
port.description: The port that the MCP server will use to communicate with the Firefox extension (default is 18789)
